usageNotes: Permanently removes a named sendmail notification endpoint from the cluster. Requires the `Mapping.Modify` privilege on `/mapping/notifications`. Any notification rules or matchers that reference this endpoint by name should be updated or removed first, as the deletion does not cascade.
destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the sendmail endpoint configuration; any notification rules referencing it will lose their delivery target and must be reconfigured manually.
tips: The endpoint name must match the pve-configid format (alphanumeric, hyphens allowed, no spaces).
List existing endpoints with GET /cluster/notifications/endpoints/sendmail before deleting to confirm the correct name.
Check notification matchers and routing rules referencing this endpoint before deletion to avoid silent notification failures.
